body.text: Astro website development at Teknoppy gives businesses fast, search-friendly websites that load almost instantly on any phone or connection. We use Astro, an open-source web framework that sends plain HTML to the browser and adds JavaScript only where a page truly needs it.
Our in-house team in Thykoodam, Kochi, builds Astro sites for clients across Kerala, India, the UAE and Qatar.

paragraphs.text: Astro is a web framework built for content-driven websites. Instead of sending a large JavaScript bundle with every page, it builds pages into static HTML ahead of time and ships zero JavaScript by default. Interactive parts, such as a search box or a booking widget, load on their own when needed.
This makes Astro website development a strong fit for company sites, blogs, documentation and campaign pages, where fast loading and clear content matter more than complex app features.

sections.h2: What Astro Services Does Teknoppy Offer?

items.title: Astro Marketing Website
items.html: An Astro marketing website suits companies that rely on search and ads for enquiries. Pages load quickly, layouts stay stable while loading, and every page carries its own title, description and structured data. As an Astro web design company, we design each page around one clear action, such as a call, a form or a WhatsApp message.

items.title: Astro Content Site and Blog Development
items.text: An Astro content site handles hundreds of articles, guides or product pages without slowing down. Astro blog development uses Astro content collections, which check every post for a title, date, author and summary before the site is built, so missing details are caught early. Posts can also be grouped by topic, author or date without any extra plugins.

items.title: Astro Documentation Site
items.text: An Astro documentation site gives software companies and manufacturers fast, searchable manuals and help pages. Readers find answers quickly, and your support team receives fewer repeat questions.

items.title: Astro Microsite Development
items.text: Astro microsite development suits product launches, events and campaigns that need a separate, fast site for a short period. Microsites can be live within days and removed cleanly afterwards.

sections.intro: Our Astro JS development services cover four kinds of site. Each can be booked alone or combined.

paragraphs.text: Fast static website development means pages are built once and served as ready-made files from a global network. There is no database to query when a visitor arrives, so pages appear almost instantly and are much harder to attack.

Astro islands architecture is what keeps this speed when you need interactive features. Each interactive part, such as a pricing calculator or an image gallery, is an "island" that loads by itself while the rest of the page stays as plain HTML. Astro view transitions add smooth page-to-page animations without turning the site into a heavy app.
We style sites using Astro with Tailwind CSS, which keeps design consistent across every page and produces very small stylesheets.

sections.h2: Astro vs Next JS and Astro vs WordPress

paragraphs.html: Both are modern frameworks. Astro is built for content sites and sends little or no JavaScript. Next.js is built for sites that also behave like applications, with logins and live data. If your site is mostly pages to read, Astro is usually faster and simpler. If you need app features, see our Next.js development page.

WordPress is a content management system with themes and plugins that run on every visit. Astro website development produces pre-built pages with no plugins to update, which cuts security risks and maintenance time. Content can still be edited through a simple editor connected to your site.

sections.h2: How Much Does an Astro Website Cost?

paragraphs.text: How much does an Astro website cost? It depends on the number of pages, languages, integrations and custom features. A 10 page marketing site costs far less than a multilingual content site with hundreds of articles.

Every project is quoted after discovery, and the quote is fixed for the agreed scope. Hosting for static Astro sites is usually very low, because pages are served as files rather than from a busy server. Over three to five years, Astro website development often costs less to own than a plugin-heavy site, because there are fewer updates, fewer security fixes and smaller hosting bills.

items.a: Yes. Astro sends complete HTML that search engines and AI crawlers can read immediately, and its pages load fast, which supports good Core Web Vitals scores. Every page can carry its own metadata, structured data and clean URLs.

items.q: Why is Astro faster than WordPress?
items.a: WordPress builds each page on request using PHP, a database and plugins. Astro builds pages in advance and serves them as ready-made files with little or no JavaScript, so there is far less work to do when a visitor arrives.

items.q: How long does an Astro website take to build?
items.a: A 10 page marketing site usually takes 3 to 4 weeks. A large content site or multilingual project takes 6 to 8 weeks. We confirm your timeline in writing after discovery.

Yes. Astro can use components written in React, Vue, Svelte and other frameworks on the same page. Each component loads only when it is needed, so existing React work can be reused without slowing the site down.

items.q: Can my team edit an Astro website without a developer?
items.a: Yes. We connect your Astro site to a simple content editor, so your team can add pages, publish blog posts and change images through a browser. The site rebuilds automatically within a minute or two, and layout and design stay protected.
